text: In 1983, a platoon of recruits finishing basic training on a jungle island hear of a mad woman who died at 23:59 and whose spirit [returns to haunt the camp at that same minute|rules|death on a deadline]. Tan, [the platoon outcast|who_suffers|outcasts and the marginalised], insists the ghost is after him, then goes missing on a jungle march and is found dead. Jeremy dreams that Tan's ghost is pointing to the next victim, and the trail leads to the house of a medium whose deformed daughter was [shunned as cursed|wrong|the outsider punished].
